description: 한국인터넷진흥원_25년 사이버대피소 디도스 공격 대응 업종별 통계 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국인터넷진흥원. 본 데이터는 한국인터넷진흥원(KISA)이 탐지 및 집계한 디도스(DDoS, 분산 서비스 거부) 공격 피해기업의 업종별 현황을 제공하는 자료입니다. 디도스 공격은 다수의 감염 기기(봇넷) 등을 이용해 대량의 트래픽을 발생시켜 정상적인 서비스 제공을 방해하거나 시스템을 마비시키는 사이버 공격입니다. 본 데이... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국인터넷진흥원. Its tags are 정보 통신, 정보보호, 사이버위협정보, 디도스, 분산 서비스 거부 공격. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
